args.command:
cat > build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdDistGeom, rdMolDescriptors
import numpy as np
s='CP(C)c1c(-c2cc(C(C)(C)C)cc(C(C)(C)C)c2)cccc1-c1cc(C(C)(C)[CH2-])cc(C(C)(C)C)c1'
lig=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(lig),rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(lig))
for a in lig.GetAtoms(): print(a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol(),a.GetFormalCharge(), [n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetNeighbors()])
cp=Chem.MolFromSmiles('C[c-]1c(C)c(C)c(C)c1C')
print('cp',Chem.MolToSmiles(cp))
n=lig.GetNumAtoms(); m=Chem.RWMol(Chem.CombineMols(lig,cp)); ir=m.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(77)); m.GetAtomWithIdx(ir).SetFormalCharge(3)
p=1
ch=next(a.GetIdx() for a in lig.GetAtoms() if a.GetFormalCharge()==-1)
# identify ligand aryl ring with metallated tertbutyl
q=lig.GetAtomWithIdx(ch).GetNeighbors()[0].GetIdx()
r2=next(a.GetIdx() for a in lig.GetAtomWithIdx(q).GetNeighbors() if a.GetIsAromatic())
# ring ipso joined to central benzene
ring=next(list(r) for r in lig.GetRingInfo().AtomRings() if r2 in r)
r0=next(i for i in ring if any(a.GetIsAromatic() and a.GetIdx() not in ring for a in lig.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()))
r1=next(a.GetIdx() for a in lig.GetAtomWithIdx(r0).GetNeighbors() if a.GetIdx() in ring and lig.GetBondBetweenAtoms(a.GetIdx(),r2))
cpinds=[a.GetIdx()+n for a in cp.GetAtoms() if a.GetIsAromatic()]
for i in [p,ch,r0,r1]+cpinds: m.AddBond(i,ir,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
m=m.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(m); m=Chem.AddHs(m)
print('anchors',p,ch,r0,r1,'Cp',cpinds,'Ir',ir, 'atoms', m.GetNumAtoms(),rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'graph.mol')
# enforce metal-ligand distances
bm=rdDistGeom.GetMoleculeBoundsMatrix(m)
for i,d in [(p,2.32),(ch,2.12),(r0,2.3),(r1,2.3)]+[(i,2.25) for i in cpinds]:
 a,b=sorted([i,ir]);bm[a,b]=d+0.05;bm[b,a]=d-0.05
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3();params.randomSeed=281;params.useRandomCoords=True;params.SetBoundsMat(bm);params.maxIterations=3000
cid=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
print('embed result',cid)
if cid>=0:
 Chem.MolToXYZFile(m,'initial.xyz');Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'embedded.mol')
np.savez('indices.npz',p=p,ch=ch,r0=r0,r1=r1,cp=cpinds,ir=ir,n=n)
PY
